note:
Médecine Nucléaire 2024: a French review of RECIST -- its history, how it is applied, and how the criteria have been adapted. In French, which matters: the tumour board works in French and the corpus keyword leg is configured for both languages.

Distinct from the criteria document beside it, and checked rather than assumed: not one sampled sentence from the other RECIST file appears in this one. This is commentary on the criteria; that one is the criteria.

default.note: Response evaluation applies to any measurable solid tumour under treatment, whatever the disease setting. Routing it to one would hide it from the others. Serves treatment_response throughout: A review of those criteria -- their history, application and adaptation.

rules.note: One rule covers both spellings: the engine normalises `Références` and `References` to the same needle, so stating both is a repeat it refuses -- correctly, since which was meant could not be recovered.
